launcher.identity_note: The bundled launcher is byte-identical to the official v7.4.2 file. Gradle 7.4 and 7.4.1 share this hash; the bytes do not uniquely identify the generating release.

distribution.note: The launcher downloads and runs the separately configured distribution; its version is not the launcher identity.

notice_scope: LICENSE and NOTICE are complete, unmodified upstream v7.4.2 texts. The distribution NOTICE names additional distribution dependencies; preserving that full text does not assert that all those dependencies are embedded in the launcher JAR.
